segments.sn6.14:1.1: Evaṃ me sutaṃ – ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā sāvatthiyaṃ viharati … pe … tatra kho bhagavā bhikkhū āmantesi –
segments.sn6.14:2.2: Rañño kho pana, bhikkhave, aruṇavato aruṇavatī nāma rājadhānī ahosi.
segments.sn6.14:2.3: Aruṇavatiṃ kho pana, bhikkhave, rājadhāniṃ [aruṇavatiyaṃ kho pana bhikkhave rājadhāniyaṃ (pī. ka.)] sikhī bhagavā arahaṃ sammāsambuddho upanissāya vihāsi.
segments.sn6.14:2.4: Sikhissa kho pana, bhikkhave, bhagavato arahato sammāsambuddhassa abhibhūsambhavaṃ nāma sāvakayugaṃ ahosi aggaṃ bhaddayugaṃ.
segments.sn6.14:2.5: Atha kho, bhikkhave, sikhī bhagavā arahaṃ sammāsambuddho abhibhuṃ bhikkhuṃ āmantesi –
segments.sn6.14:2.6: ‘āyāma, brāhmaṇa, yena aññataro brahmaloko tenupasaṅkamissāma, yāva bhattassa kālo bhavissatī’ti.
segments.sn6.14:2.7: ‘Evaṃ, bhante’ti kho bhikkhave, abhibhū bhikkhu sikhissa bhagavato arahato sammāsambuddhassa paccassosi.
segments.sn6.14:2.8: Atha kho, bhikkhave, sikhī bhagavā arahaṃ sammāsambuddho abhibhū ca bhikkhu – seyyathāpi nāma balavā puriso samiñjitaṃ vā bāhaṃ pasāreyya, pasāritaṃ vā bāhaṃ samiñjeyya evameva – aruṇavatiyā rājadhāniyā antarahitā tasmiṃ brahmaloke pāturahesuṃ.
segments.sn6.14:3.1: “Atha kho, bhikkhave, sikhī bhagavā arahaṃ sammāsambuddho abhibhuṃ bhikkhuṃ āmantesi –
segments.sn6.14:3.2: ‘paṭibhātu, brāhmaṇa, taṃ brahmuno ca brahmaparisāya ca brahmapārisajjānañca dhammī kathā’ti.
segments.sn6.14:3.3: ‘Evaṃ, bhante’ti kho, bhikkhave, abhibhū bhikkhu sikhissa bhagavato arahato sammāsambuddhassa paṭissutvā, brahmānañca brahmaparisañca brahmapārisajje ca dhammiyā kathāya sandassesi samādapesi samuttejesi sampahaṃsesi.
segments.sn6.14:3.4: Tatra sudaṃ, bhikkhave, brahmā ca brahmaparisā ca brahmapārisajjā ca ujjhāyanti khiyyanti [khīyanti (sī. syā. kaṃ. pī.)] vipācenti –
segments.sn6.14:3.5: ‘acchariyaṃ vata, bho, abbhutaṃ vata bho, kathañhi nāma satthari sammukhībhūte sāvako dhammaṃ desessatī’”ti!
segments.sn6.14:4.1: “Atha kho, bhikkhave, sikhī bhagavā arahaṃ sammāsambuddho abhibhuṃ bhikkhuṃ āmantesi –
segments.sn6.14:4.2: ‘ujjhāyanti kho te, brāhmaṇa, brahmā ca brahmaparisā ca brahmapārisajjā ca – acchariyaṃ vata, bho, abbhutaṃ vata, bho, kathañhi nāma satthari sammukhībhūte sāvako dhammaṃ desessatīti!
segments.sn6.14:4.4: Tena hi tvaṃ brāhmaṇa, bhiyyosomattāya brahmānañca brahmaparisañca brahmapārisajje ca saṃvejehī’ti.
segments.sn6.14:4.5: ‘Evaṃ, bhante’ti kho, bhikkhave, abhibhū bhikkhu sikhissa bhagavato arahato sammāsambuddhassa paṭissutvā dissamānenapi kāyena dhammaṃ desesi, adissamānenapi kāyena dhammaṃ desesi, dissamānenapi heṭṭhimena upaḍḍhakāyena adissamānena uparimena upaḍḍhakāyena dhammaṃ desesi, dissamānenapi uparimena upaḍḍhakāyena adissamānena heṭṭhimena upaḍḍhakāyena dhammaṃ desesi.
segments.sn6.14:4.6: Tatra sudaṃ, bhikkhave, brahmā ca brahmaparisā ca brahmapārisajjā ca acchariyabbhutacittajātā ahesuṃ –
segments.sn6.14:4.7: ‘acchariyaṃ vata, bho, abbhutaṃ vata, bho, samaṇassa mahiddhikatā mahānubhāvatā’”ti!
segments.sn6.14:5.1: “Atha kho abhibhū bhikkhu sikhiṃ bhagavantaṃ arahantaṃ sammāsambuddhaṃ etadavoca –
segments.sn6.14:5.2: ‘abhijānāmi khvāhaṃ, bhante, bhikkhusaṅghassa majjhe evarūpiṃ vācaṃ bhāsitā – pahomi khvāhaṃ āvuso, brahmaloke ṭhito sahassilokadhātuṃ [sahassīlokadhātuṃ (sī. syā. kaṃ. pī.)] sarena viññāpetun’ti.
segments.sn6.14:5.5: yaṃ tvaṃ, brāhmaṇa, brahmaloke ṭhito sahassilokadhātuṃ sarena viññāpeyyāsī’ti.
segments.sn6.14:5.6: ‘Evaṃ, bhante’ti kho, bhikkhave, abhibhū bhikkhu sikhissa bhagavato arahato sammāsambuddhassa paṭissutvā brahmaloke ṭhito imā gāthāyo abhāsi –
segments.sn6.14:8.1: “Atha kho, bhikkhave, sikhī ca bhagavā arahaṃ sammāsambuddho abhibhū ca bhikkhu brahmānañca brahmaparisañca brahmapārisajje ca saṃvejetvā – seyyathāpi nāma … pe … tasmiṃ brahmaloke antarahitā aruṇavatiyā rājadhāniyā pāturahesuṃ.
segments.sn6.14:8.3: Atha kho, bhikkhave, sikhī bhagavā arahaṃ sammāsambuddho bhikkhū āmantesi –
segments.sn6.14:8.4: ‘assuttha no, tumhe, bhikkhave, abhibhussa bhikkhuno brahmaloke ṭhitassa gāthāyo bhāsamānassā’ti?
segments.sn6.14:8.5: ‘Assumha kho mayaṃ, bhante, abhibhussa bhikkhuno brahmaloke ṭhitassa gāthāyo bhāsamānassā’ti.
segments.sn6.14:8.6: ‘Yathā kathaṃ pana tumhe, bhikkhave, assuttha abhibhussa bhikkhuno brahmaloke ṭhitassa gāthāyo bhāsamānassā’”ti?
segments.sn6.14:8.7: Evaṃ kho mayaṃ, bhante, assumha abhibhussa bhikkhuno brahmaloke ṭhitassa gāthāyo bhāsamānassa –
segments.sn6.14:11.1: “‘Evaṃ kho mayaṃ, bhante, assumha abhibhussa bhikkhuno brahmaloke ṭhitassa gāthāyo bhāsamānassā’ti.
segments.sn6.14:11.3: sādhu kho tumhe, bhikkhave! Assuttha abhibhussa bhikkhuno brahmaloke ṭhitassa gāthāyo bhāsamānassā’”ti.
segments.sn6.14:12.1: Idamavoca bhagavā, attamanā te bhikkhū bhagavato bhāsitaṃ abhinandunti.

lines: Tesu abhibhūthero sāriputtatthero viya paññāya aggo, sambhavatthero mahāmoggallāno viya samādhinā aggo.
Thero pana “pakativaṇṇaṃ vijahitvā nāgavaṇṇaṃ gahetvā dasseti, supaṇṇavaṇṇaṃ gahetvā vā dassetī”tiādinā (paṭi. ma.3.13) nayena āgataṃ anekappakāraṃ iddhivikubbanaṃ dassesi.
“kathaṃ desitā nu kho dhammadesanā sabbesaṃ piyā assa manāpā”ti.

“sabbepi pāsaṇḍā sabbe devamanussā attano attano samaye purisakāraṃ vaṇṇayanti, vīriyassa avaṇṇavādī nāma natthi, vīriyapaṭisaṃyuttaṃ katvā desessāmi, evaṃ ayaṃ dhammadesanā sabbesaṃ piyā bhavissati manāpā”ti ñatvā tīsu piṭakesu vicinitvā imā gāthā abhāsi.
Maccuno senanti maccuno senā nāma kilesasenā, taṃ dhunātha.
Kiṃ pana katvā thero sahassilokadhātuṃ viññāpesīti?
Nīlakasiṇaṃ tāva samāpajjitvā sabbattha ālokaṭṭhāne andhakāraṃ phari, odātakasiṇaṃ samāpajjitvā andhakāraṭṭhāne obhāsaṃ.
Atha tesaṃ theroti vadantānaṃ imā gāthāyo abhāsi, sabbe osaṭāya parisāya majjhe nisīditvā dhammaṃ desentassa viya saddaṃ suṇiṃsu.
Ete dve tassa bhagavato aggasāvakāti dasseti.
Khiyyanti taṃ lāmakato cintetabbataṃ pāpenti pāpakataṃ karonti.
Sabbe pāsaṇḍā attano attano samaye siddhante sabbe devamanussā attano attano samaye paṭilābhe paṭiladdhaatthe purisakāraṃ vaṇṇayantīti yojanā.
Payogaṃ karothāti paraṃ paraṃ ṭhānaṃ akkamanato tatopi balavataraṃ bhāvanābhiyogaṃ pavattethāti attho.
Kilesasenā nāma rāgādikilesasamūho, so maraṇapaccayabhāvato “maccuno senā”ti vuccati.
Khandhānaṃ paṭhamābhinibbatti jāti, tadaññaṃ pana tesaṃ paṭipāṭi pavattaṃ saṃsāroti adhippāyenāha “jātiñca saṃsārañcā”ti.

Yasmā “ekampi jātiṃ dvepi jātiyo”tiādīsu tasmiṃ tasmiṃ bhave ādānanikkhepaparicchinnakhandhappavatti “jātī”ti vuccati, sā eva yāva parinibbānā aparāparaṃ pavattamāno saṃsāro “ito cito saṃsaraṇan”ti katvā, tasmā āha “jātisaṅkhātaṃ vā saṃsāran”ti.
Ālokakiccaṃ natthīti andhakāraṭṭhāne ālokadassanaṃ viya ālokaṭṭhāne ālokadassanakiccaṃ natthi.
Tasmā tesaṃ sattānaṃ “kiṃ āloko ayaṃ, kassa nu kho ayaṃ āloko”ti?
Saddaṃ suṇiṃsūti na kevalaṃ saddameva suṇiṃsu, atha kho atthopīti yathādhippeto tesaṃ pakatisavanupacāre viya pākaṭo ahosi, tisahassilokadhātuṃ viññāpesīti.
